Mateo — thanks for the ping. Draft notes / recommended language below; attaching a redline for the addendum (DPA_UK_Addendum_redline.docx) and a short order form snippet.

Key points:
- Transfer mechanism: for UK we recommend the UK Addendum + SCCs equivalent language referencing the UK International Data Transfer framework. Suggested clause: "The Parties agree to incorporate the UK Addendum as an Annex to the DPA; where applicable Redwood will rely on the UK international data transfer mechanism and SCC-equivalent terms to effect lawful transfers."
- KMS/keys: we can offer KMS key material stored in the UK under a customer-managed BYOK model for a production deployment on Private or Dedicated. Note: full HSM-backed customer control is only available for Dedicated capacity and requires 30-45 day provisioning and a minimum 3-month reserved term. If customer accepts hosted KMS (Redwood-managed) we can provide geo-fencing of keys to the UK region but cannot guarantee HSM-segregated hardware tenancy.
- Subprocessors: Marissa (please include current list). Our normal cadence is 30-day subprocessor notice and approval SLA; for UK Gov we can add a 14-day review SLA for named critical subprocessors.
- Evidence: we'll provide SOC2 Type II summary and high-level pentest report (redacted). Sensitive vulnerability detail requires an NDA which we can provide via our secure evidence portal.
- Pricing impact: Dedicated UK pool estimated +15–25% uplift over standard hosted pricing (depends on commit level). VPC/private deployment with regional egress controls is typically +10–15% and carries longer lead time for network handover. Ben: please confirm numbers for the quote.

Action items I completed: included specific redline language for the addendum (see attached). I've flagged two potential negotiation asks: (1) limit of liability carveouts tied to regional hosting (we prefer to keep consistent with MSA) and (2) expedited subprocessor review SLA.

If UK Gov wants the highest assurance, recommend proposing Dedicated UK capacity + BYOK HSM with a short pilot (30 days) and then full procurement commit. I'll be available on Mon 14:00 UK to join the call with Emma.

Karthik Iyer
Privacy & Compliance Counsel | Redwood Inference
